title: Disable Memory Integrity (HVCI)
description: Turn off virtualization-based driver protection to recover some performance.
why: Memory Integrity runs kernel code-integrity checks inside a virtualized, isolated environment. That isolation costs some CPU time, mostly on older processors and in some games.
danger: Memory Integrity stops malicious or vulnerable drivers from loading into the kernel. Turning it off makes the PC easier to compromise. Only do this if you understand the trade-off.
